subject: E-Commerce
title: The Whole Foods Acquisition
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Whole Foods Acquisition.

hook.text: Amazon bought Whole Foods for $13.7 billion in 2017. On the same day, grocery stocks lost $12 billion in value.

buildup.text: Amazon needed physical stores for grocery delivery. Whole Foods had 500 locations in affluent neighborhoods.

discovery.text: Amazon immediately cut Whole Foods prices on day one. Prime members got extra discounts. Foot traffic surged.

twist.text: Whole Foods stores doubled as Prime delivery hubs. Grocery was the wedge into every household.

climax.text: The acquisition showed Amazon would cross from digital to physical whenever it had strategic value.

punchline.text: $13.7B for Whole Foods. Grocery stocks lost $12B same day. Fear is a weapon.

quiz.question: Why did Amazon buy Whole Foods?
options: For 500 physical locations as delivery hubs in affluent areas
To enter the organic food market
